CASE FILE · DALLAS 1963

Case Never Closed

The JFK Assassination Cover-Up in the Government's Own Declassified Words

Coming soon · By JR Korvus

No one was ever put on trial for killing President Kennedy. The only man charged was shot dead two days later. This book uses the government's own released papers to show what was hidden, how it was hidden, and why the case never closed.
